name: HK Green Mini Bus Arrival
description: Real-time GMB (Green Mini Bus) arrival information for Hong Kong using the official Transport Department API.
author: Steven Ho - Security hardened 2026-09-17

security.caching: TTL-based with configurable expiration and size limits (max 1MB per cache file, 512KB for routeFareList)
security.inputValidation: strict (route format ^\d{1,3}$, direction enum [1,2], region enum [HKI,KLN,NT], stopName pattern [\w\s\u4e00-\u9fff.,()\-/]{1,100}, control char rejection)
externalApis: https://data.etagmb.gov.hk (official HK Transport Dept - route, stop, ETA)
security.notes: Data sourced from official HK government APIs only. Cache stored locally in skill directory with size limits. No credential storage. All inputs validated at schema and runtime level. URL allowlist enforced to prevent SSRF. Generic error messages returned to user; details logged internally only. Large routeFareList.json (8MB) is NOT bundled - fetched lazily at runtime with size limit, only needed entry extracted.

tools.name: searchRoutes
tools.description: Search for GMB route numbers. Returns matching regions and optionally suggestions if not found.

tools.name: getGMBArrival
tools.description: Get the next 3 arrival times for a GMB route at a specific stop. Requires route number, direction (1 or 2), stop name (English or Chinese), and region (HKI/KLN/NT).

direction.description: Direction sequence: "1" for terminus A → B, "2" for B → A

stopName.description: Stop name (partial or full, English or Chinese)

region.description: Region code: "HKI" (Hong Kong Island), "KLN" (Kowloon), or "NT" (New Territories)

executionModel.note: Runtime MUST invoke via argument array (shell=False) to prevent command injection. Example: ["python3", "gmb_arrival.py", "getGMBArrival", route, direction, stopName, region]
